name: Ultimate Vocal Remover
title: Ultimate Vocal Remover: free Moises alternative
caption:
Moises Premium charges $5.99/month for unlimited vocal splitting. Ultimate Vocal Remover does it for free 🎤

✅ Splits any song into vocals and instrumental
✅ Make a karaoke track from your own audio files
✅ Runs on your own computer with AI models built in
✅ Save as WAV, FLAC or MP3

💻 Windows · Mac
ℹ️ It's a big download, and it's slow without a good graphics card (Nvidia GTX 1060 6GB or better is recommended). Moises has a limited free plan; Premium is $5.99/month or $39.99/year

Comment "KARAOKE" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

Follow @itsongit for a new free open-source find every day

#opensource #github #karaoke #music #vocalremover #freeapps #musicproducer #techtips
dm_pitch: Ultimate Vocal Remover, the free open-source Moises alternative 🎤

facts.fact: Removes vocals from songs using AI source-separation models
facts.readme: This application uses state-of-the-art source separation models to remove vocals from audio files.

facts.fact: Models were trained by the UVR developers (not Demucs 4-stem)
facts.readme: UVR's core developers trained all of the models provided in this package (except for the Demucs v3 and v4 4-stem models).

facts.fact: Includes Demucs 4-stem models, so it can split drums/bass/other too (README only says '4-stem'; stem names not stated)
facts.readme: except for the Demucs v3 and v4 4-stem models
These bundles contain the UVR interface, Python, PyTorch, and other dependencies needed to run the application effectively. No prerequisites are required.
This installer is intended for those running Windows 10 or higher.

facts.fact: Mac: Apple Silicon and Intel builds; macOS Big Sur and above
facts.readme: Mac M1 (arm64) users ... Mac Intel (x86_64) users ... This bundle is intended for those running macOS Big Sur and above.
MPS (GPU) acceleration for Mac M1 has been expanded to work with Demucs v4 and all MDX-Net models.

facts.fact: GPU: Nvidia GTX 1060 6GB minimum for GPU conversions, 8GB VRAM recommended
facts.readme: Nvidia GTX 1060 6GB is the minimum requirement for GPU conversions. / Nvidia GPUs with at least 8GBs of V-RAM are recommended.

facts.fact: Heavy on hardware, speed depends on your PC
facts.readme: Conversion times will significantly depend on your hardware. / These models are computationally intensive.

facts.fact: AMD/Intel Arc: DirectML build for Windows (limited)
facts.readme: If you use an AMD Radeon or Intel Arc graphics card, you can try the DirectML version

facts.fact: Needs 64-bit; installs to C: drive on Windows
facts.readme: This application is only compatible with 64-bit platforms. / You must install UVR to the main C:\ drive.

facts.fact: Also has time-stretch and pitch-shift tools
facts.readme: This application relies on the Rubber Band library for the Time-Stretch and Pitch-Shift options.
The application will automatically remember your settings when closed.
This project is 100% open-source and free for anyone to use and modify as they wish.

facts.fact: Output formats WAV/FLAC/MP3 and 'Vocals Only' / 'Instrumental Only' checkboxes (seen in README screenshot, not README text)

screenshots.what_it_shows: Real v5.6 window, dark theme: Select Input/Output, WAV/FLAC/MP3, process method MDX-Net, model MDX23C-InstVoc HQ, GPU Conversion ticked, Vocals Only / Instrumental Only checkboxes, Start Processing. It is the idle UI (no progress bar, empty log), not mid-task. Portrait, so crop or letterbox on app beats.
UVR6 PREVIEW from issue #2399 (unreleased PySide UI, input Blackout.mp3, 'Instrumental + Vocals' stems). Not the app people can download today, so excluded.

_research.contributors: 8 total (Anjok07 698 commits, DilanBoskan 63, djkcyl 7, aufr33 4, four with 1). Really a one-person project.
_research.last_release: v5.6 - UVR GUI, published 2023-09-26; ~3.64M downloads on UVR_v5.6.0_setup.exe alone, 624k arm64 dmg, 287k x86_64 dmg. Newer beta/patch assets (Jan 2025 DirectML 'UVR_1_15_25_22_30_BETA_full.exe' 277k downloads, Roformer betas) were uploaded to the same release.
_research.install_notes: Windows: run UVR_v5.6.0_setup.exe from Releases (Win10+, install on C:). Mac: .dmg for arm64 or x86_64 (Big Sur+); first launch can take 5-10 min; may need 'sudo xattr -rd com.apple.quarantine' because unsigned. Linux: NO installer, manual python venv + apt/pacman + 'python UVR.py'.
_research.maintenance: Last commit 2026-10-06 is a README-only edit announcing 'UVR 6' (Tkinter to PySide) with 'a new release within six weeks' (issue #2399, sole active developer). Previous commit 2025-03-13 (README). Last real release 2023-09 (betas to Jan 2025). 1570 open issues. Not abandoned but slow.
_research.price_notes: Moises Premium via US App Store IAP list: Premium Monthly $5.99, Premium Yearly $39.99, Pro Monthly $29.99. App Store description: 'Premium Plan: Unlimited AI audio separation and stem extract ... Up to 180 minutes of audio separation per upload'; free plan has vocals/drums/bass separation. moises.ai/pricing redirects to the home page and plans are JS/app-only, so the web price could not be read; the $3.99/month backlog figure is NOT confirmed (may be a web annual-billed promo). Prices from App Store can differ from web.
doubts: Official web pricing page not readable; price is from the App Store IAP list (US storefront).
Not star-farmed: 2020 repo, 8 contributors, millions of downloads. But effectively single developer.
README has no explicit 'offline' wording; 'bundles contain Python, PyTorch' implies local, and models ship in the package, but do not say 'works offline' as a README fact.
README does not list stem names; only 'Vocals Only', 'Instrumental Only' in screenshot and '4-stem' for Demucs.
README says nothing of karaoke explicitly; keyword is our framing (instrumental output).
Only one usable README screenshot, idle UI, not mid-task; demo uses it as a single image.
Linux has no installer so platforms omit Linux.
Free Moises tier already separates vocals/drums/bass; the paid gain is unlimited/longer uploads, so the 'pays for' hook should say unlimited.

beats.say: There's a free app that pulls the vocals out of any song, and nobody talks about it.
Moises charges six bucks a month for unlimited splits. This one costs nothing.
Drop in a song, pick Vocals Only or Instrumental Only, and hit Start.
Make karaoke tracks, sing covers, or sample the beat.
Almost twenty seven thousand people on GitHub swear by it.
